about: Stop reason codes (#881): why a task failed or was cancelled, as the settings window shows it in its language. The bot logs a code after its English stop line (agent/reasons.py), the runner sends its own and the bot's in the task event (runner/protocol.py), and the window fills {name} with the code's params (gui/src/reasons.ts), a {team} param (a team's id) with that team's name in the settings. A reason with no code shows its English text. A code's params are the {name} placeholders of its sentences, the same in both languages. The webhook carries the English text alone; the logs have the code line after the English stop line.

ClientOutdated.zh_tw: 遊戲版本過舊。到 Play 商店更新遊戲，再按「開始」。
ClientOutdated.en_us: The game client is out of date. Update it from the Play Store, then press Start again.

HomeInBattle.zh_tw: 遊戲正在戰鬥中。手動結束戰鬥，再按「開始」。
HomeInBattle.en_us: A battle is on. End it by hand, then press Start again.

DownloadOff.zh_tw: 遊戲要下載資料，但「自動接受下載與更新」是關閉的。
DownloadOff.en_us: The game asks to download data, but "Accept downloads and updates" is off.

UpdateOff.zh_tw: 遊戲有更新，但「自動接受下載與更新」是關閉的。
UpdateOff.en_us: The game has an update, but "Accept downloads and updates" is off.

UpdateRepeats.zh_tw: bot 啟動後，遊戲已經要求更新 {times} 次。
UpdateRepeats.en_us: The game asked for an update {times} times since the bot started.

TermsOff.zh_tw: 遊戲要同意使用者條款，但「自動同意使用者條款」是關閉的。
TermsOff.en_us: The game shows the User Agreement, but "Accept the User Agreement" is off.

AssembleLost.zh_tw: 沒有到達換腦啡肽的視窗或主畫面。
AssembleLost.en_us: The Charge Enkephalin window or the main window did not come up.

ChargeLost.zh_tw: 沒有到達換腦啡肽的視窗或主畫面。
ChargeLost.en_us: The Charge Enkephalin window or the main window did not come up.

ExpLost.en_us: No known screen came up for 60 s.

ThreadLost.en_us: No known screen came up for 60 s.

ClaimMailLost.en_us: The bot did not claim the mail.

PassLost.zh_tw: 沒有到達通行證任務頁面。
PassLost.en_us: The pass missions page did not come up.

Stuck.zh_tw: 遊戲卡住了，恢復沒有成功。
Stuck.en_us: The game was stuck, and recovery did not get past it.

RetriesUsedUp.zh_tw: 隊伍全滅，重打次數用完了。
RetriesUsedUp.en_us: The whole team died, and no retries are left.

ForfeitsInARow.zh_tw: 連續放棄了 {runs} 局，不再開新的一局。
ForfeitsInARow.en_us: The bot gave up {runs} runs in a row, so it starts no new run.

GraceUnaffordable.zh_tw: 星光不夠買計畫中的加成。
GraceUnaffordable.en_us: There is not enough Starlight for a planned grace.

LuxDefeated.zh_tw: 戰鬥失敗，{retries} 次重打都用完了。
LuxDefeated.en_us: The team lost the battle and used up its {retries} retries.

NoTeamPicked.zh_tw: 這個任務沒有選隊伍。到它的選項選一支。
NoTeamPicked.en_us: No team is picked for this task. Pick one in its options.

TeamDeleted.zh_tw: 隊伍「{team}」已經刪掉了。到這個任務的選項選另一支。
TeamDeleted.en_us: The team "{team}" was deleted. Pick another one in the options of this task.

SinnersShort.zh_tw: 隊伍「{team}」的出戰順序只剩 {alive} 位罪人活著，需要 {need} 位。
SinnersShort.en_us: Only {alive} sinners of the deployment order of team "{team}" are alive, and it needs {need}.

NoSinnerAlive.zh_tw: 隊伍「{team}」出戰順序裡的罪人都陣亡了。
NoSinnerAlive.en_us: No sinner of the deployment order of team "{team}" is alive.

NoEmulator.zh_tw: 找不到可以執行的模擬器。
NoEmulator.en_us: There is no emulator to run on.

ResourceFailed.en_us: The bot could not load its resource.
